self_contained_context.background: AttackResolver calculates damage for single attack: attack_power + D6 roll. Enforces business rule: dead characters cannot attack. Returns AttackResult with damage and updated defender.

business_rules.dead_attacker_validation: If attacker.is_alive == False, raise ValueError with message 'Dead character cannot attack'
business_rules.hp_flooring: Defender HP floors at 0 via Character.receive_damage()
business_rules.immutability: AttackResult contains NEW defender Character instance (original unchanged)

task_specification.name: Implement AttackResult and AttackResolver
task_specification.motivation: Core combat mechanic. Calculates damage, validates business rules (no dead attackers), applies damage immutably.
detailed_instructions: Fields: attacker_name, defender_name, dice_roll, attack_power, total_damage, defender_old_hp, defender_new_hp, defender_after
Validate: if not attacker.is_alive, raise ValueError('Dead character cannot attack')
Roll dice, calculate damage = attack_power + roll
Call defender.receive_damage(damage) to get new instance
Return AttackResult with all combat details
Test: damage calculation, HP reduction, HP flooring, dead attacker error

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Dead attacker raises ValueError('Dead character cannot attack')
